questions.q: Which organ is shown in this slide?
questions.explain: Follicles containing a central oocyte in a cellular stroma indicate the ovary.
questions.alt: A row of small follicles lies under the top edge, with a larger follicle holding a pale central cell, in dense cellular tissue.

questions.q: What are the small round structures just under the surface?
questions.explain: Primordial follicles lie in the outer cortex.
questions.alt: A row of small follicles lies under the top edge, with a larger follicle holding a pale central cell, in dense cellular tissue.

questions.q: Which feature separates ovary from testis here?
questions.explain: Follicles with oocytes are unique to the ovary.

questions.q: Which organ is shown in this slide?

questions.q: What is the large cavity lined by dark cells called?
options: The antrum of an antral follicle
The lumen of a seminiferous tubule
questions.explain: An antrum is the fluid-filled space within a developing antral follicle.
